relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: B. N. K. Sharma learned the art of debates and Vedanta under Satyadhyana Tirtha of Uttaradi Math. Sharma travelled along with Satyadhyana Tirtha from (1930 - 1944), learned all philosophical knowledge from him

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: Sharma completed his Bachelor of Arts degree in Sanskrit from University of Madras in 1931

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: Master of Arts degree in 1935 from Presidency College, Chennai.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: Sharma received his Ph.D. from University of Madras in 1948 for his thesis on the origin and development of the Dvaita School of Vedanta and its literature.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: Sharma started his teaching career as a lecturer at Annamalai University at the age of 22 in 1931 until 1938.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: In 1938 he became principal of Government Sanskrit College in Thiruvayur until 1948.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: In 1948 he worked as a research scholar in Vishveshvaranand Vedic Research Institute in Punjab.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: In 1950, he started working as a principal at Poornaprajna Sanskrit College in Udupi.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.evidence: In 1952 he became Principal Dr. A. V. Baliga College, Kumta for a short time of one year.

relations.subject: Bhavani Narayanrao Krishnamurti Sharma
relations.role: professor and Head of the Department of Sanskrit
relations.evidence: In 1953 he finally landed in Maharashtra, where he was appointed as professor and Head of the Department of Sanskrit in Ruparel College in Mumbai and retired in 1969.
